digest: A friendly heads-up from the community: Alyson Filippa is helping spread the word about 'Family Style Medicine Theater,' a mythic story journey for kids happening the Sunday after Thanksgiving - a lovely option for families looking for something special that weekend. There's also been talk about a hand-made film, 16 years in the making with no AI, that some families plan to see this week.
